description: Seal a past window of the tape into a FILM: the bars replayed one by one with the trader's drawings and marked levels, optionally the structure computed over the bars (pivots, legs, swings and the range they share, none drawn before the bar that confirmed it) and a rehearsed machine's trades. Returns the film's public link, where it plays and can be downloaded as a video. 24 to 360 bars; the window must be in the past. A film is a replay of what printed: say so, and never present it as a forecast.

headline.description: the headline's first part (drawn in parchment), at most 44 characters

headline_gold.description: the headline's second part (drawn in gold)

kicker.description: a short line at the right, e.g. price → structure

machine.description: include the trades of the trader's rehearsed machine on this market, labelled a rehearsal

marks.description: include the trader's marked levels (default true)

reveal.description: show those scripts' rules (their transitions' conditions in plain words and their params) to anyone with the link. Only when the trader explicitly asks to reveal them; never by default

scripts.description: up to two of the trader's OWN kept cubicle.scripts, by name: each is run over the window and filmed as it acted (state band, entries and exits, stop, target and trail, its running result), labelled a rehearsal, with chapters at its moments

structure.description: draw the computed structure and name the chapters after it

title.description: a short name beside the wordmark

to.description: window end, ISO-8601 UTC, in the past

name: film
